title: AKM Markdown Asset Envelope
description: The common frontmatter envelope every AKM markdown asset type carries: type/description/tags/when_to_use/xrefs/updated/timestamp, plus the OKF v0.2 machine-stamped families (generated/verified/provenance/status/stale_after). Per-type schemas (e.g. akm-workflow.json) $ref these definitions individually into their own top-level `properties` so `additionalProperties: false` still sees them declared locally (JSON Schema does not merge `allOf` siblings' properties for that check). This file has no `properties`/`required` of its own — it is a definitions-only library.

type.description: The asset's type token (e.g. "workflow"). Drives recognition alongside directory residence.

when_to_use.description: Guidance on when this asset should be applied/selected.

xrefs.description: Canonical asset refs this asset cross-references. Ref canonicality is checked by semantic validation, not this schema.

timestamp.description: Legacy creation/authoring timestamp, pre-dating OKF v0.2's `generated:`.

actorStamp.description: One OKF v0.2 actor stamp: who (by) and, usually, when (at).

generated.description: OKF v0.2 machine-stamped authorship — the replacement for the legacy `timestamp` key.

verified.description: OKF v0.2 machine-stamped verification(s). A bare mapping or a list of them; independent confirmations accumulate.

provenance.description: Namespaced OKF v0.2 provenance (kept nested because a bare top-level `sources:` collides with the AKM-native wiki citation-string convention).

stale_after.description: OKF v0.2 staleness horizon (a date or duration, author-maintained).
